text.en: Jaspreet and Gulnaz organise a langar at a Gurudwara for about one thousand people. Fifty-five volunteers will serve.

Jaspreet and Gulnaz plan a community lunch called a langar. They expect around one thousand (1000) people.
Fifty-five people volunteer. They receive many donations and write the quantity as numbers.
10 hundreds make 1 thousand. Our blocks are: a small cube is 1, a rod is 10, a flat is 100 and a big cube is 1000.
A four-digit number has thousands, hundreds, tens and ones. 3,425 is 3 thousands, 4 hundreds, 2 tens and 5 ones.
They record the number of people at different times, such as 52, 145, 325 and 508, and draw them with blocks.
The time slot with the most people has the biggest number.
